html:
SMTO-BOOT-0020 — The installer needs curl or wget to download Conda

GUID: bcae84f8-c53b-4929-bdd0-bf4622245145
Slug: boot-download-tool-missing
Domain: BOOT · Subsystem: boot

What happened

  • No Conda was found, so the installer tried to download it. That needs a download program, curl or wget, and this computer has neither. Nothing was downloaded or installed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Install curl with your computer's software installer, for example sudo apt install curl on Ubuntu or Debian. The installer uses curl, or wget if curl is missing, to fetch Miniforge, the package that contains Conda.
  2. Open a new terminal and run curl --version to confirm it is installed. This confirms the installer will find the download program before you start again.
  3. Check that the Conda folder named after "Installing Conda via Miniforge in" still doesn't exist, then run the same installer command again. This attempt stopped before creating that folder; the installer won't install Conda into a folder that already exists.

What success looks like

  • The installer downloads Miniforge, prints "Using Conda:" and continues with the installation.

If it still fails

  • Copy the full terminal output, including the SMTO-BOOT-0020 line and the Error reference line, and send it to the person who manages this computer. If curl is installed but the download fails, also check that this computer can reach github.com, where Miniforge is downloaded from.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • install-vllm.sh needed to bootstrap Miniforge but found neither curl nor wget on PATH; it exited before downloading, and its EXIT trap removed the temporary download directory.

What this means

  • Miniforge download setup finds neither curl nor wget available. The installer has created a temporary download directory but has not downloaded or installed Miniforge; its EXIT trap removes that temporary directory. Finding a download tool does not establish network connectivity, trust or availability of the Miniforge release.

Why this can happen

  • Miniforge download setup finds neither curl nor wget available.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the host PATH and package-manager installation of the download tools.

How to fix it

  • Install curl or wget with the host package manager and confirm it is on PATH, check that the target CONDA_HOME (default ~/miniforge3) still does not exist, then rerun install-vllm.sh. The Miniforge installer is fetched from github.com/conda-forge/miniforge releases, so network access to GitHub is also required.
  • Install curl or wget through the host package manager, then run the installer again.

Retry and execution caution

  • Make curl or wget available on PATH and confirm the chosen Conda destination is still unused before installing again.

How to verify the fix

  • One supported download tool is available to the installer.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • The installer has created a temporary download directory but has not downloaded or installed Miniforge; its EXIT trap removes that temporary directory.
  • Finding a download tool does not establish network connectivity, trust or availability of the Miniforge release.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
